ai_summary: 20 Microns Limited reported robust Q2 FY24 results, with revenue up 6.35% and PAT surging 34.24%, driven by strong demand in key sectors and improved cost efficiencies from reduced fuel and freight expenses, pushing EBITDA margins to an optimal 14.99%. The company projects continued 15-18% YoY revenue growth, fueled by strategic international expansion, R&D in new products, and exploring joint ventures in areas like construction chemicals. While acknowledging a shorter 2-3 month market demand visibility post-COVID, management is leveraging flexible manufacturing and technology upgrades to sustain its positive trajectory.
